story_text:
## PexarBolt Ultra Dock: See Your Workflow. Control Your Desk.
## Powered by Lexar. Built on Decades of Expertise.
## Highlights from IFA
## 🏆 Award-Winning Innovation
Ports and bandwidth are only part of the story.
PexarBolt Dock’s 5-inch Touch Control Dashboard shows live port activity, power, bandwidth, displays, temperature, as well as Claude Code and Codex status at a glance.
## One Dock. Every Connection. Complete Control.
PexarBolt Ultra TBT5 Dock combines up to 120Gb/s Thunderbolt 5 bandwidth, 22 professional connections, and a 5-inch anti-glare touch dashboard in one powerful command center. Connect your displays, storage, network, card readers, accessories, and power—then monitor ports, bandwidth, charging, and temperature at a glance.
## 5-Inch Touch Control Dashboard
Most docks connect your devices. PexarBolt Dock shows you what they’re doing. Traditional docks hide everything. PexarBolt Dock shows you what matters. The built-in 5-inch Visual Dashboard gives you real-time visibility into your entire desk setup — so you can stop guessing and start controlling. Rotate the metal dial to switch between screens, press to select, or tap the display for more details.
## 22-in-1 Pro Port Matrix
22 Ports. One Streamlined Workflow. PexarBolt Ultra TBT5 Dock brings your entire setup together through a Thunderbolt 5 host port with up to 140W charging.
For high-speed devices, you get 2 Thunderbolt 5 downstream ports, plus 5 USB-C ports and 4 USB-A ports for storage, charging, and everyday accessories.
For displays, connect through the downstream Thunderbolt 5 ports, plus either DisplayPort 2.1 or HDMI 2.1 depending on your setup.
For creative workflows, built-in CFexpress Type B, SD 4.0, microSD 4.0, M.2 NVMe storage, 10GbE Ethernet, and audio connectivity keep media import, editing, backup, and networking in one place.
One dock. Less switching. Fewer adapters.
## Up to 120 Gb/s Thunderbolt 5 Bandwidth
PexarBolt Dock brings Thunderbolt 5 speed to demanding multi-display workflows, delivering up to 80 Gb/s bidirectional bandwidth and up to 120 Gb/s Bandwidth Boost in the display/output direction.
On supported Thunderbolt 5 Mac and Windows systems, it can drive up to dual 8K 60Hz displays or triple 4K 144Hz displays.
## Pro Media Workflow, Streamlined.
With PexarBolt Ultra TBT5 Dock at the center of your setup, your entire creative workflow stays connected. Import footage from CFexpress Type B, SD, or microSD cards, then back it up to an M.2 NVMe SSD inserted in the dock’s expansion slot.
Edit across up to two 8K 60Hz or three 4K 144Hz displays, transfer finished projects to your NAS over 10GbE, and keep your laptop powered with up to 140W host charging.
Less time managing devices. More time creating.
## 10GbE NAS Performance
Transfer large video projects, back up working libraries, and access shared storage at speeds of up to 10Gb/s. Connect directly to a high-speed NAS and keep demanding creative workflows moving with less waiting.
## M.2 NVMe SSD Slot
Install your own M.2 NVMe SSD directly inside the dock for fast footage backup, project storage, and everyday file access—without adding another external drive or enclosure to your desk.
*M.2 NVMe SSD is not included.
Deliver up to 140W to your laptop through the Thunderbolt 5 host port, while the two front USB-C ports deliver a shared 60W (AVS Compatible) — fully supporting the latest iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max for fast, efficient charging alongside your phones, tablets, and accessories.
## Smart Active Cooling
A 5.8 mm ultra-thin blower delivers fan-rated airflow up to 67 L/min. It draws air through 239 precision intake vents on the side panel, as well as a slotted opening around the chassis. The blower then directs the airflow straight across the Thunderbolt 5 heatsink, drive bay and other critical components.
Additionally, the built-in display shows dock thermal status and fan activity, helping users monitor heat at a glance.
## AI Workflow Status & Session Phase
AI Status turns the 5-inch display into a live command center for your AI agents.
It now supports both Claude Code and Codex/ChatGPT.
See what’s running, thinking, completed, needs attention, or offline, along with session progress and token usage at a glance. Stay on top of your AI workflows without constantly switching back to another window.
## Vibe Plugins: Build Your Own Dock Controls
Every desk workflow is different, so your dock should be too.
With Vibe Plugins, you describe what you need in plain language, AI builds it, and you preview it on your computer before it appears on the dock's 5-inch touchscreen.
Create a one-tap shortcut panel for the editing software you use every day. Show live status from a device on your local network. Or build controls for other compatible tool in your workflow. Each plugin is shaped around your own setup, not a one-size-fits-all menu.
Describe: Tell AI what you want your dock to do.
AI Builds: AI creates the plugin for you.
Preview: Test the layout and buttons on your computer first.
On Your Dock: Run it from the 5-inch touchscreen.
Working across a Mac and a PC? Soft KVM turns the 5-inch dashboard into a switch for your desk.
Tap a computer on the dock, and your monitor input and keyboard and mouse follow. Built with Vibe Plugins around your own setup, it combines monitor input switching with network-based keyboard and mouse sharing, so you can move between two computers without reaching for monitor buttons.
*Soft KVM is a software-assisted workflow, not a hardware KVM.
⚠️ USB peripherals such as webcams and storage stay connected to their original computer.
⚠️ Both computers must be powered on, awake, logged in, and on the same local network.
⚠️ Deskflow must be running on both computers.
⚠️ Monitor switching depends on DDC/CI support and your actual connection layout.
## PexarBolt Desktop & App Ecosystem
View connected devices, power, transfer activity, and thermal status through the desktop or mobile app, keeping essential information from PexarBolt Ultra TBT5 Dock within easy reach.
## Built to Perform, Designed to Impress
## Compatibility List
## One Control Dock for Every Pro Workflow
## PexarBolt Ultra USB4 Card Reader
Introducing the PexarBolt Ultra USB4 Card Reader Case—a compact 4-in-1 solution for CFexpress Type A, CFexpress Type B, SD, and microSD cards. With independent 40Gbps and 5Gbps bandwidth channels, it supports faster parallel transfers across multiple cards, while built-in storage keeps up to 15 memory cards organized and an AirTag slot adds extra peace of mind. Paired with the PexarBolt Ultra TBT5 Dock, it creates a seamless workflow from capture to editing.
*CFexpress Type A and Type B share one channel and cannot be used simultaneously.

General Product Notes

* Unless otherwise stated, computers, displays, SSDs, memory cards, adapters, and other accessories shown are not included and must be purchased separately.
* Screen images are simulated for illustration. The actual interface may vary by software version.

Pexar is powered by Lexar — an independent brand and Lexar's key ecosystem partner.
Built on Lexar's more than 30 years of expertise in storage technology, and its proven track record in performance, reliability, and product engineering, Pexar creates a new generation of smart, connected products — making advanced technology more intuitive, accessible, and better integrated into creative and professional workflows.
From smart digital frames to intelligent creative devices, Pexar is designed around one goal: helping users work and create more efficiently with technology that feels simpler, smarter, and more connected.

Since 2017, Vinyl has raised over $200M on Kickstarter and led multiple million-dollar projects, including LaserPecker ($10M+), Makera Z1 ($10M+), NestWorks ($10M+) and AnkerMake ($8M+), providing expert promotion and marketing services to drive global success.
risks: PexarBolt Dock is powered by Lexar, drawing on its extensive expertise in professional storage and high speed data solutions. The product has already undergone multiple rounds of prototyping, compatibility testing, thermal testing, and performance validation. However, as with any new hardware product, unforeseen challenges may still arise during development and production. Potential risks include shortages of critical components and delays from suppliers. Mass production may also reveal issues that were not identified during the prototype stage. To minimize these risks, we will conduct pilot production runs, quality inspections, reliability testing, and final performance validation before moving into full scale manufacturing. International fulfillment may also be affected by customs clearance, regional regulations, carrier capacity, or disruptions to global logistics. We will work closely with experienced manufacturing and logistics partners to reduce these risks and support a smooth delivery process. Should there be any changes to the project timeline, production schedule, or delivery plan, we will communicate them openly and promptly through regular Kickstarter updates.

faq.q: What is the 5-inch Touch Control Dashboard?
faq.a:
The dashboard lets you check your dock’s status without opening your computer. It shows connected devices, power usage, temperature, bandwidth, fan status, and AI workflow status. With the PexarBolt desktop app, it supports Claude Code and OpenAI Codex at launch, displaying session status, approval requests, errors, token usage, and estimated cost. 

The dashboard does not run AI itself; it only displays information from your AI workflow.

faq.q: Does PexarBolt Dock support CFexpress Type A cards?
faq.a: The dock includes a built-in CFexpress Type B reader, but not a Type A slot. You can use Type A cards with a separate Type A-to-Type B adapter, or choose an optional PexarBolt Ultra USB4 Card Reader add-on or bundle, which supports CFexpress Type A/B, SD, and microSD cards. The Type A and Type B slots cannot be used at the same time.

Shipping is planned to start in early December 2026, after the Kickstarter campaign ends.

We will share the exact production and shipping schedule in future Kickstarter updates.
